name: Grünfeld Defense
description: Black repertoire for the Grünfeld Defense, by White's system: Exchange variation, Exchange variation sidelines, Closed variation, Russian system (Qb3), Brinckmann Attack (Bf4), Neo-Grünfeld, Lutikov variation (f3), and Petrosian system (Bg5).

excluded.reason: Recorded in this chapter only as an anchor for the sibling first-move sidelines (Bg5/Bb5+/Qa4+/Be3) — 1.Bc4 itself has no continuation here and is already fully covered by the 'Exchange variation' chapter, so it isn't a real line of its own.
